commands.title: Screenshot and deterministic capture through the render stack
commands.inputs: Room or route; focus and capture options.
commands.outputs: PNG images; optional art snapshot JSON.
commands.mutation: Runs an isolated simulation; writes requested output files.
commands.build: Reuse target/debug/capture_scene or target/release/capture_scene. If absent, enable the target bind, then cargo build -p ambition_app_tools --bin capture_scene. Capture needs graphics support.
